title: PartsLab
excerpt: Manual NumPy nonnegative matrix factorization turns original 8x8 UCI digit pixels into nonnegative additive basis contributions. A scalar-JavaScript browser solves actual new nonnegative coefficients when you edit arbitrary pixels.

title: PlanBench
excerpt: Validate and simulate agent task plans before they run.

title: PolicyLens: offline policy values with visible support and clipping limits
excerpt: Dependency-free Python CLI/API for standard IPS, SNIPS, DM and DR estimators. 28 tests and Python 3.10-3.13 CI; offline demo asserts exact arithmetic and a failing clipped truth-equality gate. No new statistical method.
headings: PolicyLens: offline policy values with visible support and clipping limits
Learn reward predictions without using held-out rewards

title: PPOlab
excerpt: A PPO implementation that makes reset boundaries, credit assignment and numerical replay limits inspectable.
headings: Evidence, including the failure of exact replay

title: PrivacyLab
excerpt: PrivacyLab audits supplied finite probability tables against explicit neighboring-secret edges. It computes the smallest delta at an exact multiplicative factor t=exp(epsilon), with every directed-pair event witness and full rational arithmetic. Factor 3 means epsilon ln(3), not epsilon 3.

title: PromptGuard
excerpt: Local-first prompt linting with a complete filter, baseline and CI-gate witness.

title: ProvLab
excerpt: A finite relational-provenance workbench for symbolic data reasoning. Shared query variables perform real joins; projection and union-all collect derivations into natural-coefficient polynomials. The default p² + pq has bag multiplicity 10, exact answer-presence probability 1/2, and an intentionally invalid ordinary probability substitution of 3/8.
headings: ProvLab: one fact is not two chances
ProvLab0.2: same answers on every database
ProvLab0.3: the assumptions change the answer

title: QuantLab
excerpt: Weight-only int8 quantization from scratch, with real packed files and an independent editable browser inspector.

title: RAGLine
excerpt: Retrieval-augmented answering built from scratch in pure Python, with citations and verifiable grounding.

title: RatingLab
excerpt: Observed-only rating factorization with manual NumPy alternating ridge solves, per-block decrease accounting, normal-equation residuals and full gradients. All eleven fits remain inspectable.
headings: Evaluation without hiding the stronger control
Finite response with an explicit frozen boundary

title: RetrievalBench
excerpt: A cutoff is a policy. Offline BM25 retrieval evaluation with complete arithmetic and an independent browser inspector.
headings: Corrections with the original protocol retained

title: RewriteLab
excerpt: An exact, deliberately small arithmetic-optimization lab for inspecting the boundary between rewrite reachability and algebraic equivalence. Enumerate the whole bounded rewrite graph, inspect a shortest proof for every reachable tree, then compare it with every polynomial-equivalent tree in the same finite grammar.
headings: RewriteLab: a shortcut can need a larger detour
Why it belongs in an AI portfolio
RewriteLab budget barriers: when fitting is not reaching
RewriteLab cost atlas: one graph, every cost tradeoff
RewriteLab continuous regions: beyond a sampled cost grid

title: RiskLab: the plan you would change
excerpt: Exact finite scenario-tree decisions under static CVaR and nested conditional CVaR. A supplied tree, every full deterministic policy, every terminal probability, split boundary-atom mass and independently replayable risk certificates. Dependency-free Python 3.10+ and a separate BigInt browser inspector.
headings: RiskLab: the plan you would change
A root-optimal policy can still have a worse continuation
One tail is not a fresh tail at every node

title: RobustLab: exact linear threat-set audits
excerpt: A high clean accuracy does not certify a classifier against an explicit adversarial input budget. RobustLab makes that distinction measurable for a small class where the inner attack problem can actually be solved: binary affine scores under L1, L2 and L-infinity balls.
headings: Box intersection: an optimal witness, not a clipped candidate

title: ScanLab
excerpt: Exact affine prefix scans and input-gated state-space derivatives, with algorithmic span kept separate from real arithmetic work and floating behavior.

title: ScoreLab
excerpt: Exact policy-gradient distributions, not noisy training curves. A dependency-free finite-model laboratory for score-function gradients, reward-to-go, value baselines and variance-minimizing control variates. Full trajectory witnesses, rational means/covariances and an independently checked expected-return derivative.
headings: Matrix score controls: a full covariance certificate
A correct value baseline can make the gradient nine times noisier
Exact rational gradients at a softmax anchor
Why the optimal baseline is not the state value

title: ScratchGPT
excerpt: A NumPy GPT with hand-written autograd, a trained Shakespeare checkpoint and an inspectable exact-continuation contract.

title: SegmentLab
excerpt: A confident segmentation is not evidence that an event occurred. SegmentLab is a dependency-free Python implementation of exact offline Bayesian Gaussian changepoint inference. It retains the full finite-partition evidence and marginals, not only one best cut list.
headings: Selected results, and what they mean

title: SetGuard: classifier prediction sets with an explicit coverage boundary
excerpt: A dependency-free Python CLI/API for calibration labels plus classifier probabilities, versioned JSON artifacts and unlabeled prediction sets. This is a standard split-conformal method, not a new algorithm.
headings: SetGuard: classifier prediction sets with an explicit coverage boundary
v0.2: every inclusion has a witness

title: ShapleyLab: exact attribution for an explicit reference game
excerpt: Dependency-free Python scalar callback API/JSON CLI, 49 Python tests plus four Node/actual-Chrome tests, offline demo and Python 3.10-3.13 CI. Standard formula, no new theory.
headings: ShapleyLab: exact attribution for an explicit reference game
Counterexamples are part of the demo
